description: Returns the live operating status of a business on Are We Working: Open, Partially open, Closed, or an emergency status (Tornado Warning: Take Shelter Immediately, or Emergency Evacuation), with the business's note (for example a weather closure or delayed start) and when it was last updated. Use this to answer 'is X open / working today?'.

handle.description: The business's handle: the last part of its status page URL (areweworking.org/{handle}), e.g. 'riverside-fab'. Use search_businesses if you only know the name.

name: get_business_status
title: Get a business's current status
